title: ChatServer configuration
description: config.json for the built-in chat pipelines. Custom registered adapters and tools require extending this schema.

$schema.description: Location of this JSON schema for editor validation and completion.

chats.description: Chat pipelines served by this process. An empty array runs no adapters.

modelReference.description: <provider>/<model id>, using the provider name and model ID from models.json. Model IDs may contain additional slashes.

filters.description: Filters evaluated in order. Omit or use [] to delegate to the reply model without running filters.

tts.description: Optional voice replies through an OpenAI-compatible audio/speech endpoint returning PCM/float WAV audio. Omit to use text replies only.

options.description: Provider speech fields such as voice, speed, instructions, or language. ChatServer controls model, input, response_format=wav, and stream_format=audio.

stt.description: Optional speech-to-text settings. Omit the entire object to ignore voice input.

model.description: Required <provider>/<model id> for audio/transcriptions. There is no fallback to messager.replier.

audioConversionCmd.description: Optional shell command converting {input} to {output} as WAV. Runs in an isolated temporary directory; converter must be installed on the ChatServer machine. Without it, original audio is uploaded.

name.description: Registered transport. WeChat is the built-in implementation.

memoryTokenLimit.description: Per-conversation token budget for this pipeline's memory notes and confirmed replies, including their compact JSON metadata. Oldest entries are removed first; three-day retention still applies.

persona.description: Optional replier identity, tone, and style as a nonempty string with one or more sentences; newlines are preserved. Omit for the default helpful assistant. Applies only to the replier; output-format and reply-length requirements still apply.
examples: You are a warm, lightly humorous friend. Give practical photography advice. Keep your tone relaxed.

mainAccount.description: Exact sender ID authorized to use /status in a direct chat; usually wxid_..., not a display name.

localTools.description: Application-managed tools, selected by name strings or objects containing only type. Omit to enable all built-ins; [] disables local tools. read_image enables conversation image caching and lookup for replies and model filters. Duplicate types are deduplicated.

apiTools.description: Provider-hosted Responses API tools as type strings or definition objects with provider-specific options. Strings expand to objects with type. Omitted or [] enables none. The selected provider/model must support them; client-executed tools are not supported here.

imageGeneration.description: Enable provider-hosted image generation. Omit to enable when apiTools includes image_generation. True adds the hosted tool if missing; false removes it. Requires support from the replier's provider/model.

imageWidthLimit.description: Maximum generated image width in pixels. Combined with imageHeightLimit as the requested hosted-tool size unless a smaller concrete size is set in apiTools. The provider must support the requested dimensions. PNG output is required.

imageHeightLimit.description: Maximum generated image height in pixels. Combined with imageWidthLimit as the requested hosted-tool size unless a smaller concrete size is set in apiTools. The provider must support the requested dimensions. PNG output is required.

dailyImageGenLimit.description: Daily image generation allowance shared by this messager's conversations. Zero disables generation. Usage is kept only in memory and resets on server restart or at server-local midnight; ambiguous provider failures consume quota.

baseUrl.description: agent-wechat HTTP(S) server root, entered without `/v1` (routes add the API prefix; a trailing `/v1` is stripped), and without credentials, query, or fragment.

accountId.description: Daemon account ID from GET /v1/accounts (not a WeChat username). Omit to use the only authenticated account; multiple authenticated accounts are rejected as ambiguous.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable containing the bearer token; takes precedence over tokenFile.

tokenFile.description: Fallback bearer-token file. Relative paths resolve against the config directory; expand ~ yourself.

chatIds.description: Chat IDs to monitor. Omit to monitor all chats; mainAccount is always included when configured.

reconnectIntervalMs.description: Base delay before reconnecting the WeChat event stream, in milliseconds. Consecutive failures double the delay up to a bounded cap.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for each WeChat REST request and for opening or waiting on the event stream, in milliseconds; independent of model timeouts.

oneOf.description: Shorthand ignore filter using the default <messager>_ignore file.

file.description: Ignore-list file; defaults to <messager>_ignore in the config directory. Relative paths resolve against that directory.

senderIds.description: Inline sender IDs combined with the file's IDs. Ignored messages are excluded before buffering and model processing.

instructions.description: Decision criteria for the filter model. Thinking is disabled for filter calls.
instructions.default: Allow messages that would benefit from an assistant response. Otherwise abstain.
